title: Successive zero-code blocks
statement: For every natural number $F$, the code that initializes $F+1$ stack cells is the code that initializes the first $F$ cells followed by the instruction that subtracts the value in the constant-one cell from itself and stores the result in the stack cell indexed by the main-frame offset plus $F$.
